title: 第18章 疗伤丹药第19章 狩猎
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
石修点了点头：“我跟大师兄、二师兄都是孤儿，从小师傅就收养我们，教导我们武功，后来我们年龄大一些了，师傅觉得带着我们四海为家不是办法。”
“于是就在云梦城定居，开了家武馆，我师傅当时凭借一身练骨境界，加上旭日剑法跟闪电十三剑，整个外城也就金刚武馆的馆主冉熊能够抗衡。”
“等武馆彻底在外城立足之后，师傅尽心教导我们，希望我们能够青出于蓝，后来大师兄、二师兄就接连到了练骨境界了。”
“原本这是双喜临门，但是大师兄和二师兄跟师傅的理念产生了冲突。”
“大师兄跟二师兄觉得，武馆的资源已经不够支撑他们修炼了，而且师傅的功法也只到练骨。”
“所以想要到内城去，争取更多的资源，但是师傅不同意。”
“师傅觉得内城练骨以上的高手不少，要争取资源必然会跟其他人产生冲突。”
“到时候惹上了练骨以上的高手，师傅怕保不下他们。”
“随着时间的推移，矛盾越来越大，直到出现一件事情，一切都变了，大师兄跟二师兄不知道哪里得到的消息，听说内城新来的孙家有练髓功法，于是联手灭了孙家满门！
师傅听到这事气的急火攻心，旧病复发，这些年就算吃了不少药，也只是治标不治本，也是这时候彻底跟大师兄、二师兄划清界限的。”
说到这里，石修双手紧握，但下一刻却又像是泄了气一般，叹了一口气。
齐源看到这一幕，也知道石修对于他大师兄、二师兄肯定是有着恨，但是也有着亲情。
毕竟三人从小一起长大，虽然没有血缘关系，但都已经把彼此当做亲兄弟，把师傅当做父亲。
从梦境中就可以看出来，他们关系非常好，只是没想到最后竟然反目成仇。
“他们既然是为了练髓功法杀的孙家满门，那没有其他人为了练髓功法动手吗？”齐源问出了心中的疑惑。
石修摇了摇头：“当时孙家只是刚到内城的一个小家族而已，没人知道他们家族里有练髓功法，也不清楚大师兄跟二师兄是哪里知道的。”
“后来大师兄跟二师兄在内城创建卧虎帮，慢慢的成就了如今的练髓境界”
齐源点了点头，大概的情况已经了解，于是问道：“那你师傅的伤现在怎么样了？
一说起林永昌的伤，石修就满面愁容：“现在每天都要吃药，也不能动武，所以这次来也是想问问齐兄弟，看看齐兄弟的师傅懂不懂炼制疗伤秘药。”
齐源摇了摇头：“我师傅并不懂炼制疗伤秘药，不过...一些疗伤丹药还是会一些的。”

听见齐源说他师傅不懂炼制疗伤秘药，石修一脸失落的低着头。
但是听见后面齐源说他师傅懂得炼制疗伤丹药的时候，瞬间抬起了头。
“齐兄弟你师傅懂得炼制疗伤丹药？”石修震惊的问道。
这时他想起了以前师傅提过一嘴，有一些名门大派里面供奉着丹师，可以炼制诸多增进实力的丹药
要知道能够炼制秘药的，才有资格称之为药师，而能够炼制丹药的，称之为丹师。
天下众多药师毕生梦想都是想要成为丹师，但是能够成为丹师者寥寥无几。
只有朝廷，或者一些名门大派，世家大族才能够培养出来丹师！
丹师除了天赋要求高，还有一点就是需要大量的资源堆起来，没有大量的资源根本培养不起来一个丹师
秘药最多只能对练髓以内的境界起到帮助，而丹药就算是换血之上也可以使用。
一想到黄粱一梦的神奇，那确实是只有丹师才能炼制出来的东西
面对石修的问题，齐源点了点头说道：“以前见过师傅炼制疗伤丹药。”
石修心头大喜，要是这样的话，那他师傅身上的伤肯定会痊愈的。
content_en:
Shi Xiu nodded: "My senior brother and my second senior brother and I are both orphans. The master adopted us when we were young and taught us martial arts. Later, when we got older, the master felt that it was not an option to take us all over the world."
"So I settled in Yunmeng City and opened a martial arts gym. At that time, my master relied on his bone training level, plus the Rising Sun Sword Technique and the Thirteen Lightning Swords. In the entire outer city, only Ran Xiong, the master of the Vajra Martial Arts Gym, could compete."
"After the martial arts school was completely established in the outer city, the master taught us with all his heart, hoping that we would be able to excel. Later, the senior brother and the second senior brother successively reached the realm of bone training."
"Originally this was a double blessing, but the ideas of the senior brother and second senior brother conflicted with the master's."
"The eldest brother and the second brother feel that the resources of the martial arts hall are no longer enough to support their practice, and the master's skills are only limited to bone training."
"So I want to go to the inner city to get more resources, but the master doesn't agree."
"Master feels that there are many masters of bone training and above in the inner city, and fighting for resources will inevitably lead to conflicts with others."
"When the time comes when we offend masters of bone training and above, Master is afraid that I won't be able to protect them."
"As time went by, the contradictions became more and more serious, until something happened and everything changed. The first senior brother and the second senior brother got the news from nowhere. They heard that the new Sun family in the inner city had a marrow training method, so they joined forces to destroy the entire Sun family!
When the master heard this, he became very angry and his old illness relapsed. Even though he had taken a lot of medicine over the years, it only treated the symptoms but not the root cause. It was at this time that he completely drew a clear line with his senior brother and second senior brother. "
Having said this, Shi Xiu clenched his hands, but the next moment he seemed to be discouraged and sighed.
When Qi Yuan saw this scene, he also knew that Shi Xiu must have hatred for his senior and second senior brothers, but he also had family affection.
After all, the three of them grew up together. Although they are not related by blood, they all regard each other as brothers and the master as their father.
It can be seen from the dream that they have a very good relationship, but they did not expect that they would turn against each other in the end.
"Since they killed the whole Sun family for practicing the marrow technique, wouldn't anyone else do it for the purpose of practicing the marrow technique?" Qi Yuan asked the doubt in his heart.
Shi Xiu shook his head: "At that time, the Sun family was just a small family that had just arrived in the inner city. No one knew that there was a marrow training method in their family, and it was not clear where the senior brother and second senior brother knew about it."
"Later, senior brother and second senior brother founded the Crouching Tiger Gang in the inner city, and slowly achieved the current state of marrow training."
Qi Yuan nodded and understood the general situation, so he asked: "How is your master's injury now?
When talking about Lin Yongchang's injury, Shi Xiu had a sad face: "Now I have to take medicine every day, and I can't use force, so I came here this time to ask Brother Qi if his master knows how to refine the secret healing medicine. "
Qi Yuan shook his head: "My master doesn't know how to refine the secret healing medicine, but... he still knows some healing pills. "
After hearing Qi Yuan say that his master didn't know how to refine the secret healing medicine, Shi Xiu lowered his head in disappointment.
But when he heard Qi Yuan say later that his master knew how to refine healing elixirs, he immediately raised his head.
"Brother Qi, your master knows how to refine healing elixirs? Shi Xiu asked in shock.
At this time, he remembered that his master had mentioned before that there were alchemists in some famous sects who could refine many elixirs to increase their strength.
You must know that only those who can refine secret medicine are qualified to be called pharmacists, and those who can refine elixirs are called alchemists.
Many pharmacists in the world have a lifelong dream of becoming an alchemist, but very few can become alchemists.
Only the imperial court, or some famous sects, and aristocratic families can train alchemists!
In addition to the high talent requirements for alchemists, another point is that they need a lot of resources to pile up. Without a lot of resources, they can't be cultivated.If you don’t get up, you won’t be an alchemist.
At best, the secret medicine can only help those within the realm of marrow training, while the elixir can be used even above blood exchange.
When I think of the magic of Huangliang Yimeng, it is indeed something that only an alchemist can refine.
Facing Shi Xiu's question, Qi Yuan nodded and said, "I have seen the master refining healing elixirs before."
Shi Xiu was overjoyed. If this was the case, his master's injuries would definitely be healed.
